description: CLF-017 fail-rival: the foreign branch of our name AND a numeric rival, on a remote that refuses deletions. Only our own landed push is withdrawn, so nothing is withdrawn here (our push was rejected): the claim warns of the rival, renumbers to 002 and succeeds. Were the foreign branch read as ours, the withdrawal would be attempted on someone else's branch and refused by the remote, ending the claim with the could-not-withdraw refusal instead. Differs from fail only in the rival and the remote that refuses deletions.

.specify/scripts/powershell/create-new-f: # Fixture stub of .specify/scripts/powershell/create-new-feature.ps1. The contract scripts/claim-feature.ps1 reads:
# it is called as -Json -Number N -ShortName S <description>, must create branch NNN-S and specs/NNN-S/ and
# leave that branch checked out, and must print {"BRANCH_NAME":"NNN-S"} on stdout.
# A rival claim with our number reaches origin between allocation and the push (the race the loop exists for).
# A second claimant with the same number AND the same short name has already pushed this very branch name (an unrelated commit).
# Git's hints about a rejected push vary by version; the fixture switches them off so the expectation does not.
